2610.13703.title: A Baseline Assessment for the Agentic Web Technology Stack
2610.13703.paper_summary: The fast pace in which protocols, frameworks, and technologies are being proposed for LLM-based agents results in a complex scenario for anyone aiming to create state-of-the-art AI solutions. Without an assessment on how different protocols, frameworks, and libraries work together to compose an Agentic Web solution, developers and organizations face different challenges (e.g., skilling, governance, infrastructure) even before becoming part of the Agentic Web ecosystem. In this context, we propose a system for performing Agentic Web evaluations called MASTIF (Multi-Agent System TestIng Framework) and present a baseline assessment of Agentic Web technologies, including 3 LLMs, 3 protocols, and 4 agent implementation frameworks, against 300 Mind2Web benchmark tasks. Results suggest that selecting a task-specific technology stack may result in gains of task completion rate, efficiency score, and social value stability scores; and reductions in verbosity and time to complete tasks. With the presented results, we expect to present a baseline in terms of metrics and results for this complex and fast evolving scenario for those aiming at designing, assessing, and developing multi-agent systems.
2610.13703.paper_summary_zh: 快速提出的協議、框架和技術，使得基於LLM的代理人創建最先進AI解決方案的任何人面臨複雜的情況。<lb/>在沒有評估不同協議、框架和庫如何協同工作以組成Agentic Web解決方案的情況下，開發者和組織在成為Agentic Web生態系統的一部分之前，就面臨著不同的挑戰（例如，技能、治理、基礎設施）。<lb/>在這種背景下，我們提出了一個名為MASTIF（Multi-Agent System TestIng Framework）的系統，用於進行Agentic Web評估，並呈現了對Agentic Web技術的基準評估，包括3個LLM、3個協議和4個代理實現框架，針對300個Mind2Web基準任務進行評估。<lb/>結果表明，選擇特定任務的技術堆棧可能會提高任務完成率、效率得分和社會價值穩定性得分；並減少冗長性和完成任務所需的時間。<lb/>基於所呈現的結果，我們期望為那些旨在設計、評估和開發多代理系統的人提供一個基準，無論是在指標還是結果方面，以應對這一複雜且快速演變的情況。
